blocking_reasons.reason: The exact binaural looming source and original left and right conditioning waveforms are unavailable. Absolute output levels, hardware calibration and timing from recorded sound onset are unreported.
The output scheduler needs independent left and right conditioning channels alongside the headphone channels and chest target. Catch trials suppress only the chest target.
The trial scheduler needs a condition-specific block order with a reversed second half and a dedicated constant-level white-noise baseline with its own chest-target and catch trials.
Exact baseline trial allocation and catch counts by condition and block are unreported.
The response scheduler needs numeric-keypad capture timestamped relative to the chest target.
